metadata_aliases_from_existing_records.model_identifier: online linear predictor; no language-model calls

persistent_state_cap.own_feature_api: Current weights and unlabeled A/B features generated by the learner's own supplied fixed encoder; no additional experience-dependent persistent state. Zero initialization, fixed map and A-then-B rank-one updates remain supplied contracts.
persistent_state_cap.learned_update_spans: Current weights, canonical bases estimated from actual A and B update deltas, current unlabeled A query feature; no gains, labels, boundary weights, geometry IDs or arm IDs. At most four additional floating scalars plus rank/context metadata persist.
persistent_state_cap.erased_geometry_view: Current weights and current unlabeled A query only; deliberately removes the original model's callable B feature map as well as the update-span trace. Its ambiguity result is not an impossibility result for the original supplied-map learner.

alias_provenance: Language and hardware from original environment; lock hash from pre-run freeze; config and generator from original resolved config; zero token budget follows explicit zero model calls in config/manifest and fixed code; persistent-state declaration from frozen config. This is export, not new measurement.
verification_scope: Original exact-inventory auditor applies to the pre-export file inventory; original and additional checksum inventories together describe the expanded archive.
